acceptance: The independently computed sha256 of the file on disk equals the sha256 of the content that was asked for, and equals the digest the adapter itself reported.
independence: The verifier does not import or call the adapter; it reads the filesystem directly.
method: Invoke the bound adapter once on a fresh path, then confirm the bytes on disk through a separate code path (pathlib.read_bytes + hashlib.sha256) that shares no code with the adapter.
objective: Establish whether text.file.write really writes the exact bytes it is given to a repository-local file, so that the registry can carry proof instead of an unverified claim.
